name: nuworks-co-op-extension
description: A powerful Chrome Extension designed to help Northeastern University students optimize their co-op search on NUWorks (Symplicity). This tool adds advanced filtering, resume matching, and bulk automation features to the standard NUWorks interface.

scripts.build: npm run clean && parcel build src/index.html src/custom.html src/bench.html src/background.js src/embeddings-worker.js --dist-dir dist --no-cache --no-source-maps --public-url ./ && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist/ort/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.wasm',{force:true})"
